Paragraph: "This hum of bees, which once brought delight when Seetha sat beside me, now echoes like a mournful song..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Re-interpreting familiar natural sounds based on current emotional loss.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama contrasts his past perception of the bees' humming with his present painful interpretation.
Outcome/Resolution: He observes how context changes pleasure into emotional pain.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Low Mood: Loss of Joy in Past Pleasures

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Parinamavada (Change in subjective experience based on inner emotional shift)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Demonstrates that external objects possess no inherent joy or sorrow; experience is determined by internal alignment and connection.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Cognitive re-appraisal influenced by depression: previously joyful stimuli are re-interpreted as mournful due to acute grief.
